portraitEditPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel-art NPC portrait for the same apocalypse game. Edit the attached existing portrait. REQUIRED CHANGE: rotate/reconstruct this exact person's HEAD AND SHOULDERS into a perfectly STRAIGHT-ON FRONTAL portrait facing the camera, with both eyes looking directly at the viewer, nose centered vertically, neither cheek in profile, shoulders square. Not a three-quarter view, not just a change of gaze. Preserve recognizable character identity: same age, gender, face structure, hair color and haircut, scars/freckles/glasses/bandana/braid where present, clothing colors and accessories. Preserve the approved chunky pixel-art medium, deliberately connected color clusters, hard stepped contours, selective dark outlines and crisp graphic shading; no smooth painting, airbrush, blur, photo noise or new decorative details. Keep natural facial asymmetries, do not create a mechanical mirror copy. Square canvas, head/shoulders to upper chest, all hair in frame with a little headroom, shoulders fill lower corners. Actual transparent background, no checkerboard drawing, no scene, no text, no frame or UI. Face must clearly be frontal. Do not change the person's costume or identity. Output one character only.
